method_note: This is a 2-layer MLP encoder trained on 9 structural features (NOT a graph encoder). The primary GNN result uses lane-graph topology (N=72 tiles, cross-cosine=-0.160). This extended experiment provides N=30+ balanced auto/manual comparison with permutation testing.
interpretation: Encoder is NOT_COLLAPSED (noise self-cosine < 0.95). Cross-cosine between auto and manual centroids = 0.1236. Negative cross-cosine indicates the structural feature distributions of auto-generated and manually authored tiles occupy distinct regions of the latent space, consistent with the primary GNN finding (cross-cosine=-0.160 on N=72 graph tiles). See permutation_test_n30.json for statistical significance.
